text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> Incident INC-2026-042: API Gateway edge tier reporting sudden spike in 502/504s. 15m 5xx rate 7.8%. first seen ~1782345600. link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-2026-042

emily: oncall here, acknowledging. looking into it now. paging eng-infra and eng-runtime. @raj @mike please join.

raj: pulling dashboards — https://grafana.redwood/board/edge-gw. seeing upstream connection resets and a tail of long latencies starting ~1782345600. TCP resets to upstreams cluster-infer-*.

mike: traffic spike concentrated on /v1/generate POSTs. top region us-west-2, spike from a small set of API keys.

emily: immediate mitigations I want:
1) scale api-gateway replicas (+autoscaler checks)
2) bump envoy/upstream timeout to 60s temporarily
3) apply emergency rate-limit for noisy keys to protect backend
4) enable fallback routing to smaller-model cluster for a fraction of traffic

emily: running scale now:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/api-gateway --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/api-gateway
```

olga: scaled to 12 replicas, rollout reported healthy. pods Ready=12/12.

olga: applying envoy timeout patch (hot reload):
```
# envoy bootstrap patch (applied via config-service)
PATCH /v1/config/envoy
{
  "route_config": {
    "timeout": "60s"
  }
}
```

raj: after scale + timeout, 502 spikes dropped significantly (from 7.8% -> ~2.1%). 504/timeouts still elevated. upstreams showing prolonged request handling times (50-120s).

nate: looking at backend logs — a bunch of long-running model requests with seq_len=2048 and large prompt sizes from a single API key key_abc123. Replay shows many concurrent long calls exhausting worker pool.

mike: applying emergency throttle on that API key via rate-limiter service: set qps=5 for 10m. command in console (applied): `rate-limiter set key_abc123 qps=5 ttl=600`

mike: applied. will monitor.

emily: customer impact assessment: roughly 42 customers experienced >1% increase in 5xx; top 3 customers (names redacted) saw sustained failures for ~6-12 minutes before mitigation. flagging for CSC outreach. severity: currently Sev2 (elevated user impact, partial mitigation in place).

sophia: support opening tickets for the affected customers (TCK-2345, TCK-2346), adding notes about timeframe and mitigation.

raj: further mitigation — enabling fallback routing for 10% of traffic to fallback cluster with smaller models to reduce backend pressure. using control-plane rollout:
```
# temporarily route 10% traffic matching /v1/generate to fallback-cluster
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/rollouts -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","percent":10,"target":"fallback-cluster"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
```

olga: rollout applied. verifying: traffic sample shows ~9.8% traffic now hitting fallback.

raj: metrics update 5m after fallback & throttles: 502 -> 0.6%, 504 -> ~1.0%. overall error budget stabilizing. backend worker queue depth reduced by ~45%.

emily: great. I'm going to hand off primary to @raj for RCA and postmortem. I'll be offline in ~30m but reachable by DM. Postmortem owners: @raj, @olga.

raj: acknowledged. next steps: collect heap/dump from affected backends, correlate heavy API key patterns, check batching/kv-cache pressure, and consider adaptive throttling / model-size gate for large seq requests.

olga: note — we saw an incremental deploy of a batching change ~1782342000 but it was healthy on staging. capturing pod logs + envoy traces now and saving to s3://incidents/INC-2026-042/ for analysis.

nate: pulled sample request trace from key_abc123 — long KV cache misses + recompile path triggered repeatedly. adding to RCA artifacts.

emily: incident status: mitigated (partial). mitigation actions in place (scale, timeout bump, key throttles, fallback routing). continuing monitoring for 1h. handoff to @raj.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 acknowledged by emily -> status: Mitigated (partial) at 1782346123.

raj: I'll keep the channel updated with deep-dive findings and timeline. closing the live triage thread but keeping PD incident open until RCA complete.

emily: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
